games.short_description: 沉浸在一個音樂與林地奇幻交織的世界中，施展法術就像演奏歌曲般輕鬆自如。在這款劇情導向的女巫學院RPG遊戲中，你將上課學習、打理學校花園、與同學與鎮民建立友誼，並探索島上諸多奇聞異事與謎團。

games.short_description_en: Become immersed in a musical woodland fantasy world where casting a spell is as easy as playing a song. Attend classes, grow the university garden, make friends with classmates and townsfolk, and explore the island’s many oddities and mysteries in this story-driven witch academy RPG.
